title: Optional Module for Comparative Risk Analysis of Free Trade Zones (Module 4)
organizations: United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime
publisher: United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime
purpose: Compare the relative risk profiles of multiple FTZs
Rank FTZs for supervisory and operational prioritization
Identify zone-specific threats, vulnerabilities and control gaps

model.assumptions_page: Hidden by default; can be revealed by right-clicking an Excel worksheet tab.
model.documentation_rule: All changes to indicators, weights or assumptions must be justified and documented.

inherent_risk_factors: Complexity of supply chains and trade transactions

relationship_to_core_tool.master_template: Module 4 does not directly feed the Master Template for Overall TBML Risk.
relationship_to_core_tool.jurisdiction_without_multiple_ftzs: Use is generally unnecessary unless a more granular zone assessment is desired.

documentation_requirements: Changes to indicators, weights or model assumptions

source.title: Self-Assessment Guidance Manual for Trade-Based Money-Laundering Risk Assessment Tool
source.publisher: United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime
